question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Wonderful
solution:
The correct answer is: **Amazing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Wonderful"** means something that is extremely good, marvelous, or inspiring delight. (अद्भुत)
 
 
• **Example:** The view from the top of the mountain was wonderful and breathtaking.
 
 
 
• **"Amazing"** refers to something that causes great surprise or wonder; it is often used to describe something that is extremely good or impressive. (अद्भुत)
 
 
• **Example:** She gave an amazing performance that captivated the entire audience.
